{'translation': 'The first 20 minutes of the match were played with great intensity, and after the "cooling break," players from both sides received yellow cards — England midfielder Elliot Anderson and Argentina centre-back Lisandro Martínez. Before half-time, almost every whistle was met with cheers from the home crowd and jeers aimed at the opposition\'s fouls.', 'note': 'Original text is already in Traditional Chinese.'}

{'translation': "The two sides went into half-time level, and after switching ends, the second half got under way. In the 55th minute, England's Anthony Gordon received a pass and fired a powerful shot to break the deadlock, giving England a 1:0 lead and sending the England fans in the stadium into wild celebration.", 'note': 'Original text is already in Traditional Chinese.'}

{'translation': 'After falling behind, Argentina launched a counter-attack. Within 10 minutes, they created three attacks with crosses from the right flank, but all were blocked, drawing sighs from many Argentina supporters. In the 85th minute, Enzo Fernández headed in from a Messi delivery to level the score at 1:1, and Argentina fans immediately banged drums and blew horns in frenzied celebration.', 'note': 'Original text is already in Traditional Chinese.'}

{'translation': "In stoppage time, in the 92nd minute, Messi provided an assist and Lautaro Martínez struck the decisive blow to seal the win, helping Argentina advance to the final once again, where they will face Spain for the World Cup title. Argentina fans in the stadium erupted again, and even after the referee's final whistle, supporters continued embracing each other in celebration, with some holding up cardboard cutouts of Messi.", 'note': 'Original text is already in Traditional Chinese.'}

{'translation': 'Argentina fan A-ho said he had been a Messi supporter ever since the player first rose to prominence at Barcelona. Wearing Argentina\'s "two-star" number 10 jersey, he noted that this World Cup is Messi\'s last, and that the team must defend its title. He believed that amid the controversies surrounding his idol Messi and the team throughout the tournament, instead of arguing with fans over every refereeing decision, supporters should cherish the final days of Messi representing the national team. He joked that although he is young and strong enough to stay up all night, he chose to stay overnight at the shopping mall with other fans to enjoy the occasion, saying the atmosphere was', 'note': 'Original text is already in Traditional Chinese.'}

{'translation': 'England fans have been singing "Football\'s coming home!" throughout the tournament, but have once again failed to bring football home. Declan, who is studying in the UK, returned to Hong Kong during the summer break and turned out today draped in an England flag, cheering loudly with friends during the fierce encounter. He said it was his first time watching a match in a shopping mall to soak up the atmosphere, and felt that although fans were fully engaged, they respected one another and there were no excessive clashes.', 'note': 'Original text is already in Traditional Chinese.'}

{'translation': 'Disappointment is inevitable when the team you support loses. Declan, who shares the same name as England midfielder Declan Rice, believed England\'s performance in this match was more than respectable. A fan of two World Cups, he said bluntly: "We\'ve waited 60 years — waiting another 4 years is nothing!"', 'note': 'Original text is already in Traditional Chinese.'}

{'translation': 'Argentina will face Spain on the 20th in the title defence, while the third-place playoff on the 19th will see England take on France.', 'note': 'Original text is already in Traditional Chinese.'}
